snippet.title: Prince Jackson's intimate memories of his father | Sunrise
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson, Michael Jackson's eldest son, shares intimate memories of his childhood with the King of Pop in his only Australian interview. The 29-year-old executive producer discusses growing up at Neverland Ranch, his father's parenting style, and private moments like stargazing on rooftops in the Middle East. He reflects on the emotional experience of watching his cousin Jaafar portray his father in the new blockbuster biopic that's breaking box office records worldwide.

snippet.title: Prince Jackson Opens Up: Michael Jackson’s Legacy, the Michael Movie & Moments Fans Never Knew
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson joins us for an emotional and insightful conversation about the new Michael movie, the legacy of Michael Jackson, and what it meant to see his cousin Jafar Jackson transform into the King of Pop on screen.

In this wide‑ranging interview, Prince shares never‑before‑heard stories from the making of the film, including powerful moments on set, emotional performances recreated for the big screen, and the responsibility he felt as an executive producer protecting his father’s legacy. 

He opens up about the human side of Michael Jackson—his philanthropy, compassion, and impact on generations of fans around the world.

Prince also discusses:

- Watching the Michael movie for the first time
- Jafar Jackson’s dedication and performance
- Colman Domingo’s portrayal of Joe Jackson
- Michael Jackson’s influence on pop culture today
- Personal childhood memories, from toy store takeovers to quiet walks with his dad
- The mission behind Heal Los Angeles and continuing Michael’s humanitarian work
- What could come next in a potential Michael Part Two

This is a must‑watch conversation for Michael Jackson fans, music lovers, and anyone inspired by stories of legacy, family, and artistic greatness.

🎬 Watch, like, subscribe, and share with fellow MJ fans.

CHAPTERS:
00:00 – Prince Jackson’s Most “Michael” Childhood Memory
Toy store shutdowns, privacy, and growing up Jackson
02:01 – Seeing the Michael Movie on the Big Screen
Why IMAX matters and how emotional the experience was
03:14 – Jafar Jackson’s First Transformation Moment
The camera test that stopped Prince in his tracks
05:44 – Neverland, Havenhurst & Family Stories Fans Never Knew
The giraffe story, Disney inspiration, and MJ’s creative world
08:42 – How Jafar Perfected Michael’s Voice & Movement
Why Prince thought he was hearing unreleased MJ audio
11:31 – Michael Jackson’s Humanity & Philanthropy
The burn unit scenes and why they mattered most
14:14 – Why Michael Jackson Is Still the GOAT
40+ years later and still shaping music and culture
16:02 – Colman Domingo as Joe Jackson
A nuanced portrayal of a complicated figure
18:10 – Prince Jackson’s Role as Executive Producer
Protecting the legacy and ensuring authenticity
22:30 – What’s Next: Michael Part Two & Message to Fans
The future of the story and Prince’s words to MJ fans

snippet.title: ‘Michael’: Jaafar Jackson Shares Advice Dad Jermaine Gave Him About Playing King of Pop (Exclusive)
snippet.description:
Jaafar Jackson opens up to ET's Kevin Frazier about playing his late uncle, Michael Jackson, in the King of Pop's self-titled biopic (out April 24) at the Berlin premiere. Jaafar reacts to getting the opportunity to play Michael on the big screen, and shares the advice his father, Michael's brother, Jermaine, gave with him before tackling the challenge. Plus, Jafaar opens up about how emotional it is to see his famous uncles and grandmother, Katherine Jackson, beam with pride over his performance.

snippet.title: Jaafar Jackson Reveals Hardest Michael Performance to Recreate for King of Pop Biopic (Exclusive)
snippet.description:
Jaafar Jackson is with ET's Kevin Frazier in Berlin ahead of the release of Michael Jackson's biopic, 'Michael'. Jaafar, who plays his late uncle in the film, reveals the hardest Michael performance to recreate on screen, and how many people he had to beat out to land the role of a lifetime. Plus, Jaafar takes ET through an immersive Michael Jackson fan pop-up experience in Germany, where he gets to see all of the iconic costumes that were recreated for the film. 'Michael' hits theaters on April 24.
